Swift Evolution

Swift 6.4

Introduction

Cette page liste l'ensemble des propositions d'évolution de la version Swift 6.4

Liste des SE

Il y a 23 propositions :

  • SE-0493 - Support async calls in defer bodies
  • SE-0494 - Add isTriviallyIdentical(to:) Methods for Quick Comparisons to Concrete Types
  • SE-0498 - Expose demangle function in Runtime module
  • SE-0499 - Support ~Copyable, ~Escapable in simple standard library protocols
  • SE-0502 - Exclude private initialized properties from memberwise initializer
  • SE-0504 - Task Cancellation Shields
  • SE-0506 - Advanced Observation Tracking
  • SE-0507 - Borrow and Mutate Accessors
  • SE-0508 - Array expression trailing closures
  • SE-0509 - Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) Generation for Swift Package Manager
  • SE-0511 - swift package add-target-plugin Command
  • SE-0514 - Hashable Conformance for Dictionary.Keys, CollectionOfOne and EmptyCollection
  • SE-0518 - ~Sendable for explicitly marking non-Sendable types
  • SE-0519 - Ref and MutableRef types for safe, first-class references
  • SE-0520 - Discardable result use in Task initializers
  • SE-0521 - Improved Syntax for Optionals of Opaque and Existential Types
  • SE-0522 - Source-Level Control Over Compiler Warnings
  • SE-0523 - Hashable conformance for UnownedTaskExecutor
  • SE-0524 - Add withTemporaryAllocation using Output(Raw)Span
  • SE-0525 - Safe loading API for RawSpan
  • SE-0527 - UniqueArray
  • SE-0528 - Continuation — Safe and Performant Async Continuations
  • SE-0530 - Async Result Support
